notes: §1985:VI.5.9.4 GR5: the character-string 'must contain at least one 'A' or 'X' and must contain at least one 'B' or '0' (zero) or '/' (slant)', drawn from A X 9 B 0 /. AnalyzeCharacterString's A/X arm is entered only by a string holding an A or an X, admits only A X 9 and the symbols CobolEdit.IsEditedCategorySymbol names (B 0 /), and keeps the string as the EditMask exactly when one of B 0 / is present, which is the item's alphanumeric edited identity; a B 0 / string with no A or X goes to the numeric-edited arm instead, and PictureComposition.Precedence refuses any other symbol beside an A or X. The one symbol 2023 adds to the set, an EDITING character-1, cannot arrive at 85: VersionConformancePass VisitPictureClause refuses the phrase with COBOL0900 (probed). Sentence b's two or more characters follow from the two required symbols, each counted in the size. Probed at --std 85: PIC XBX, A0A, 9/X, AB and B9X0 edit 'AB', 'AB', '1Z', 'QR', '7Q' to 'A B', 'A0B', '1/Z', 'Q ', ' 7Q0' through FormatSimpleInsertion; PIC 9B9 is numeric edited; PIC XX,XX, X.X, XXZ, A+ and X$ are refused (COBOL1935). The witness edits PIC XXBXX and PIC X/X0X.

next.reason: 1985: alphanumeric edited uses only 'A', 'X', '9', 'B', '0', '/' and 'must contain at least one A or X and must contain at least one B or 0 (zero) or / (slant)'. §2023:13.18.40.4 GR7: 'at least one symbol A or one symbol X, and at least one instance of character-1 or one of the symbols from the set B, 0, /': character-1 of the new EDITING phrase is an added way to make an item alphanumeric-edited. Allowed combinations are those of §2023:13.18.40.3 SR2 (precedence table); content per symbol in §2023:13.18.40.4 GR14. Looser through the added symbol.
